description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to Pod Disruption Budgets and eviction policies, including specifications, status, and related constants.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudgetSpec
classes.description: Specifies the desired state and policies for Pod Disruption Budget.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudgetStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a Pod Disruption Budget.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudget
classes.description: Defines a Pod Disruption Budget object for managing pod disruptions.

classes.name: PodDisruptionBudgetList
classes.description: A list of Pod Disruption Budget objects.

classes.name: Eviction
classes.description: Represents a request to evict a pod from its node, as a subresource of Pod.
